Hi Evelyn — thanks for the details and the attachments. Quick checklist so we can process this change: 
1) Confirm vendor EIN exactly as registered (for tax record matching).
2) Signed vendor-change form (we've emailed a fillable PDF) or a DocuSign approval from an authorized signatory.
3) Copy of the voided check (we have it), W-9 on file (we have it).
4) Confirmation that the account name on the bank matches the vendor legal name (Evergreen Labs).

Link to our vendor change form: https://redwood.app/vendor-change-form (please complete and sign). For the PO liaison change we require an authorization letter or DocuSign (we can accept the DocuSign link you mentioned). Once we receive the signed form and confirm EIN, AP will create a separate payment node and we will update the ship-to in the vendor profile and PO routing.

Cc'ing Monica (procurement) and Grace (AP) to triage internal steps. Expect an update within 2 business days after we receive the signed documents.
